Single clip replaces the previous sound or video when you trigger another. Layered mixes clips, including repeated copies of one video. This also controls the live preview. Microphone routing applies in both modes.

Records the video stage with the selected output mix, including microphone and effects routed to that output. Maximum 15 minutes / 500 MB.

Export your arrangement

Patch bay Molovox Labs
QUICK START
Wheel: zoom · Ctrl + wheel: move sideways · Space + drag or drag the background to pan100%

Make a connection: drag from a right-hand socket to a left-hand socket, or click the two sockets. Click a cable to unplug it. Right-click to cancel a connection or node move. Drag node headers to arrange your rack. Multiple cables into an effect mix those sources; its output can feed multiple destinations. The microphone switch and output volume above still apply.

Effects and parameters
